Olaf

Top Weird but works

On-hit Top Olaf

How to play this build

Pick up your axes (Q) to slow and chase relentlessly; Blade + Wit's End give insane on-hit DPS. The ult (Ragnarok) makes you CC-immune: pop it, dive straight at the carry, and nothing will stop you.

Skill order

Max priority:

W Golpes Viciosos → Q Contracorriente → E Golpe Temerario

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Vicious Strikes (W) for the attack speed and lifesteal that power on-hit; unlike damage Olaf who maxes E.

Items and what they do

  1. Blade of the Ruined King % max-health on-hit and lifesteal; active steals move speed. Melts tanks.
  2. Wit's End Attack speed and MR; magic on-hit that also steals the target's MR.
  3. Trinity Force All-in-one: AD, attack speed, crit, health, mana, move speed and the Sheen proc.
  4. Mercury's Treads Boots with MR and tenacity (reduced CC duration).
  5. Frozen Mallet Lots of health and some AD; your auto-attacks slow the target (permaslow).

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/9/0 — Offense
Why this page
21/9/0 gives damage with durability to dive and stick to the carry.
